evidence.claim: The same card fingerprint (card, billing region, account start, email) appears in 3 confirmed-fraud closed case(s): CC-4942, CC-4721, CC-4436 (out_of_region_use)
Customer report: 'I never made this $39.08 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3491361.

Retrieved guidance applied: R2 Customer denies the transaction. Recommend BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE. Add FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

Retrieved guidance applied: Out-of-region use: card-present purchases in a billing region the cardholder has no history in while normal activity continues at home. Several days of purchases in one new region is a trip, not a clone.

case.summary: The customer reported a $39.08 purchase they did not make, triggering an investigation of three recent in-person transactions totaling $124.08. The evidence showed the same card fingerprint appeared in three confirmed-fraud cases, pointing to fraud. The pattern was out-of-region use, and the fraud probability was 0.96. The card was blocked and a case was created, which was then closed as fraud.
